# remart

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Huber-group-EMBL/remart/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Huber-group-EMBL/remart/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

The remart package is a reimplementation of the biomaRt package, using the same interface, but with a different backend under the hood.
Indeed, the biomaRt package relies on the biomart online utility. But this utility is no longer maintained and is likely to be retired soon.

This package aims to offer a familiar interface to biomaRt but with a more modern and better maintained backend, through the REST API provided by Ensembl.

**Note that all biomaRt functionality is not yet implemented in remart. Only a subset of commonly used functions and queries are currently supported. After the first release, a co-creation process with the user community will guide further development.**

## Installation

You can install the development version of remart like so:

``` r
pak::pak("Huber-group-EMBL/remart")
```

## Example

```{r example}
library(remart)
remart::getSequence(
  seqType = "gene_exon_intron",
  type = "ensembl_gene_id",
  id = "ENSG00000001497"
)
```
